author: Linnaeus, 1758
habitat: 여름에는 툰드라의 호숫가, 그 밖의 시기에는 바다
summary: 국내에서는 포항에서 발견된 적이 있는 도둑갈매기류이다. 여름에는 툰드라 지대의 호수 근처에서 지내고 나머지 시기는 바다에서 보낸다. 바위 사이 땅 위에 풀로 엮은 오목한 둥지를 만들며, 알은 올리브 갈색 바탕에 짙은 갈색 점이 있다. 알류샨 열도, 알래스카 북부, 캐나다, 그린란드 남부 등지에 분포한다.

points.en: straight, pointed projecting central tail feathers

art.subject: Parasitic Jaeger (Stercorarius parasiticus), adult pale morph in breeding plumage, as seen at sea off Korea on spring and autumn passage: dark grey-brown cap reaching just below the eye; cheeks and neck sides white washed pale yellow; upperparts and wings uniform dark grey-brown; often a diffuse grey-brown breast band; belly white, vent grey-brown; tail dark with two straight, pointed central feathers projecting beyond it. Bill dark grey-black, rather slender, with a hooked tip; dark eye; legs and feet black.
art.pose: flying low over the sea, side view
art.scene: open sea off the Korean east coast; no people, buildings or text
views: adult pale morph breeding, side view standing: dark grey-brown cap, yellowish-white cheeks and neck, uniform dark brown back and wings, white belly with a faint breast band, slender hooked dark bill, black legs
adult pale morph, in flight seen from above: uniform dark brown back and wings with white primary shafts, two short pointed central tail feathers projecting straight beyond the tail
adult dark morph, in flight seen from below: entirely dark brown body and underwing except a pale flash at the base of the primaries, pointed central tail feathers
art.build: Medium-sized, slim skua, about 46cm including the tail projection, roughly the length of a Black-tailed Gull but slimmer and falcon-like. Bill shorter than the head, fairly slender, with a hooked tip. Wings long, narrow and sharply pointed; tail wedge-shaped, with two straight, pointed central feathers extending a short way beyond the rest. Legs short and black. In flight a white flash on the outer primaries (white shafts above, a larger pale patch below); fast, agile pursuit of terns and gulls.
avoid: Do not paint the whole head black like a hooded gull; only the cap is dark, the cheeks and neck are pale yellowish-white.
Do not paint broad, twisted, spoon-tipped tail feathers (Pomarine Jaeger) or very long thin streamers (Long-tailed Jaeger).
Do not paint a thick, heavy, pale-based bill (Pomarine Jaeger).
Do not paint grey gull-like upperparts or a yellow bill.
